page.content:
West Germany wins; Cruyff's Netherlands becomes the beautiful loser.

How 1974 FIFA World Cup connects

  • Character: Johan Cruyff — Cruyff's Netherlands reached the 1974 World Cup final and lost.
  • Concept: Total Football — Total Football had its World Cup stage in 1974.

What is 1974 FIFA World Cup?

The 1974 World Cup in West Germany gave the hosts the trophy and the world Total Football — Cruyff's Netherlands lost the final and still entered the canon.

Key threads lead to Johan Cruyff and Total Football.
